title: NullPointerException
description: The program crashes when accessing a property of an object that has not been initialized.
root_cause: The object reference is null when the program tries to access one of its fields or methods.
solution: Initialize the object before accessing its properties. Alternatively, check whether the reference is null.

title: ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException
description: The program tries to access an array element using an index outside the valid range.
root_cause: The index is negative or greater than or equal to the array length.
solution: Check that the index is between zero and array length minus one before accessing the array.

title: IndexError: List Index Out of Range
description: A Python program attempts to retrieve an element from a list using an invalid index.
root_cause: The list is shorter than expected or the program calculates an invalid index.
solution: Check the list length and validate the index before accessing the element.
fixed_code:
items = [10, 20, 30]
index = 2
if 0 <= index < len(items):
    print(items[index])

title: Segmentation Fault
description: A C program crashes because it accesses memory that it is not permitted to access.
root_cause: Possible causes include dereferencing an invalid pointer, accessing memory after it has been freed, or accessing memory outside an array.
solution: Check pointer validity, ensure allocated memory is used correctly, and validate array boundaries.

title: SyntaxError
description: Python cannot parse a statement because the code violates its syntax rules.
root_cause: Possible causes include missing colons, unmatched parentheses, or incorrectly structured statements.
solution: Inspect the reported line and correct the syntax according to Python rules.
fixed_code:
if number > 0:
    print(number)

title: TypeError: Unsupported Operand
description: A Python operation fails because its operands have incompatible types.
root_cause: The program attempts an operation that is not supported for the supplied data types.
solution: Check the types of the operands and convert them when appropriate.
fixed_code:
age = int(input("Enter age: "))
print(age + 1)

title: NumberFormatException
description: Java cannot convert a string into the requested numeric format.
root_cause: The input string contains characters or formatting that cannot be parsed as a number.
solution: Validate the input before parsing it and handle NumberFormatException when necessary.

title: KeyError
description: A Python dictionary lookup fails because the requested key does not exist.
root_cause: The program accesses a dictionary using a key that is absent from the dictionary.
solution: Check whether the key exists or use the dictionary get method when an optional value is acceptable.
fixed_code:
student = {"id": 7}
print(student.get("name", "Unknown"))

title: IndexOutOfBoundsException
description: A Java list operation fails because the requested index is outside the list's valid range.
root_cause: The index is negative or is greater than or equal to the list size.
solution: Check the list size and ensure the requested index is valid.

title: Null Pointer Access in C++
description: A C++ program attempts to access an object through a null pointer.
root_cause: The pointer does not refer to a valid object when the program dereferences it.
solution: Initialize the pointer appropriately and verify that it refers to a valid object before dereferencing it.

title: Python ZeroDivisionError
description: A Python program crashes when dividing a number by zero.
root_cause: The divisor evaluates to zero during division.
solution: Check whether the divisor is zero before performing the division.
fixed_code:
number = 10
divisor = 0
if divisor != 0:
    result = number / divisor
    print(result)
else:
    print("Cannot divide by zero")

title: Python AttributeError
description: An error occurs when calling a method on an object that does not support it.
root_cause: The object does not have the requested attribute or method.
solution: Check the object's type and available attributes before calling the method.
fixed_code:
name = "Ada"
name = name + " Lovelace"
print(name)

title: Python IndentationError
description: Python refuses to execute code because a block is incorrectly indented.
root_cause: Inconsistent indentation or a missing indented block.
solution: Use consistent indentation, preferably four spaces per level, and ensure blocks are correctly indented.
fixed_code:
if True:
    print("Hello")

title: Python infinite recursion
description: A recursive function keeps calling itself until the program raises RecursionError.
root_cause: The recursive function lacks a reachable base case or fails to make progress toward it.
solution: Add a valid base case and ensure each recursive call moves closer to that case.

title: Python list modified during iteration
description: Some elements are skipped when removing items from a list inside a loop.
root_cause: Removing elements shifts later elements while the loop advances its index.
solution: Iterate over a copy, build a filtered list, or use a suitable list comprehension.
fixed_code:
numbers = [1, 2, 2, 3]
numbers = [value for value in numbers if value != 2]
print(numbers)

title: Python mutable default argument
description: A function unexpectedly shares list values between separate calls.
root_cause: A mutable default argument is created once and reused across calls.
solution: Use None as the default and create a new list inside the function when the argument is None.
buggy_code:
def add_item(item, items=[]):
    items.append(item)
    return items

print(add_item("a"))
print(add_item("b"))
fixed_code:
def add_item(item, items=None):
    if items is None:
        items = []
    items.append(item)
    return items

print(add_item("a"))
print(add_item("b"))

title: Python UnboundLocalError
description: A function fails when reading a variable that is also assigned inside it.
root_cause: Python treats the variable as local because it is assigned in the function, but it is read before assignment.
solution: Initialize the local variable before reading it or explicitly declare the intended scope when appropriate.
buggy_code:
count = 10
def show_count():
    print(count)
    count = 5

show_count()
fixed_code:
def show_count():
    count = 5
    print(count)

show_count()

title: Python file not found
description: Opening a file raises FileNotFoundError even though the developer expects the file to exist.
root_cause: The path is incorrect or the program's working directory differs from the expected directory.
solution: Verify the file path and working directory, and use pathlib to construct reliable paths.

title: Python invalid dictionary key
description: Using a list as a dictionary key raises TypeError.
root_cause: Lists are mutable and unhashable, so they cannot be dictionary keys.
solution: Use an immutable hashable value such as a tuple when its elements are hashable.

title: Python incorrect string formatting
description: A formatted message displays unexpected values or raises an exception.
root_cause: The format specifier does not match the supplied value or the placeholders and arguments do not align.
solution: Check the format specifiers and arguments, or use f-strings for straightforward formatting.
fixed_code:
name = "Mia"
age = 20
print(f"Name: {name}, age: {age}")

title: Java ClassCastException
description: A Java program crashes when casting an object to an incompatible type.
root_cause: The object's runtime type is not compatible with the requested cast.
solution: Use compatible types and instanceof checks where appropriate before casting.

title: Java ConcurrentModificationException
description: Iterating over a collection fails after the collection is structurally modified.
root_cause: A collection is modified during iteration in a way that violates its iterator's rules.
solution: Use the iterator's remove method when supported, or modify the collection outside the iteration.

title: Java InputMismatchException
description: Reading user input with Scanner fails when the input has an unexpected type.
root_cause: The entered token does not match the type expected by the Scanner method.
solution: Validate input before parsing and handle InputMismatchException where appropriate.
buggy_code:
Scanner scanner = new Scanner("abc");
int age = scanner.nextInt();

title: Java NoSuchElementException
description: A program crashes when requesting an element that is not available.
root_cause: An iterator, scanner, or collection operation requests an element when none is available.
solution: Check availability with the appropriate hasNext or emptiness check before retrieving the element.

title: Java StackOverflowError
description: A Java application terminates after excessive nested method calls.
root_cause: Deep or infinite recursion exhausts the thread's call stack.
solution: Fix recursive termination conditions or use an iterative algorithm when appropriate.

title: Java resource leak
description: An application leaves files or other resources open after using them.
root_cause: Resources are not reliably closed on every execution path.
solution: Use try-with-resources for resources that implement AutoCloseable.

title: Java NumberFormatException while parsing
description: Parsing a numeric string fails when the input contains invalid characters.
root_cause: The string is not a valid representation of the requested numeric type.
solution: Validate the input format and handle NumberFormatException when parsing may fail.

title: Java incorrect string comparison
description: Two strings containing the same text are incorrectly treated as different.
root_cause: The program uses == to compare string references instead of comparing their contents.
solution: Use equals for content comparison, and use Objects.equals when null-safe comparison is needed.

title: Java ArrayStoreException
description: Storing an incompatible object in an array raises ArrayStoreException.
root_cause: A runtime array component type rejects the assigned object.
solution: Ensure the assigned value is compatible with the array's actual component type.
fixed_code:
String[] values = new String[1];
values[0] = "42";

title: Java deadlock
description: Multiple Java threads stop making progress while waiting for locks.
root_cause: Threads acquire locks in conflicting orders and wait indefinitely for one another.
solution: Acquire locks in a consistent global order and reduce unnecessary nested locking.

title: C segmentation fault from null pointer
description: A C program crashes when accessing memory through a null pointer.
root_cause: The program dereferences a pointer that does not point to a valid object.
solution: Check pointer validity and ensure it points to a valid object before dereferencing it.

title: C buffer overflow
description: Writing beyond an array's bounds corrupts memory or causes a crash.
root_cause: The program writes more data than the destination buffer can hold.
solution: Track buffer capacity, validate input lengths, and use bounds-checked logic.

title: C use after free
description: A program accesses memory after it has been released with free.
root_cause: A pointer is dereferenced after the allocated object's lifetime has ended.
solution: Do not use pointers to released memory; clear pointer variables when appropriate and manage ownership carefully.

title: C memory leak
description: A long-running C program consumes increasing amounts of memory.
root_cause: Dynamically allocated memory is no longer reachable but has not been released.
solution: Track ownership of allocations and call free when the memory is no longer needed.

title: C missing null terminator
description: String functions read beyond the intended end of a character array.
root_cause: A character array does not contain a terminating null character within its bounds.
solution: Reserve space for the null terminator and ensure strings are terminated before using string functions.
fixed_code:
char word[4] = "cat";
printf("%s\n", word);

title: C incorrect scanf argument
description: Reading a value with scanf produces incorrect results or undefined behavior.
root_cause: The format specifier and destination argument type do not match, or the required address is missing.
solution: Match format specifiers to the correct types, pass appropriate addresses, and check scanf's return value.

title: C integer overflow
description: An arithmetic operation exceeds the range of a signed integer type.
root_cause: The computed value cannot be represented by the signed integer type, causing undefined behavior in C.
solution: Check operation bounds and use a suitable type or a safe arithmetic approach.
buggy_code:
int a = INT_MAX;
int b = a + 1;

title: C++ dangling reference
description: A function returns a reference to a local variable that no longer exists.
root_cause: The referenced local object is destroyed when the function returns.
solution: Return by value or return a reference only to an object whose lifetime safely exceeds the reference's use.

title: C++ invalid iterator
description: Using an iterator after a vector changes its storage causes undefined behavior.
root_cause: An operation such as vector reallocation invalidates existing iterators.
solution: Follow the container's iterator invalidation rules and reacquire iterators after invalidating operations.

title: C++ memory leak from raw allocation
description: Dynamically allocated memory is not released when an object is no longer needed.
root_cause: The program loses track of allocated memory or fails to release it.
solution: Prefer RAII and smart pointers such as unique_ptr or shared_ptr where appropriate.

title: JavaScript TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined
description: Accessing a property of an undefined variable causes a TypeError.
root_cause: The variable has no assigned object value when the property is accessed.
solution: Check that the variable exists before accessing its properties, or use optional chaining when appropriate.
fixed_code:
const user = undefined;
console.log(user?.name ?? "Unknown user");

title: JavaScript ReferenceError: Variable is not defined
description: A JavaScript program fails because a variable name cannot be resolved.
root_cause: The variable was not declared in an accessible scope or its name is misspelled.
solution: Check the spelling, declare the variable correctly, and verify its scope.
fixed_code:
const userName = "Ada";
console.log(userName);

title: JavaScript asynchronous function returns undefined
description: A function returns a Promise instead of the expected resolved value.
root_cause: Asynchronous code is not awaited, or a value is not returned from the asynchronous function.
solution: Use async and await correctly and return the expected value from the function.

title: JavaScript array map does not return values
description: An array created using map contains undefined entries.
root_cause: The callback uses a block body without returning a value.
solution: Add an explicit return statement inside the callback or use an expression body.
fixed_code: const doubled = [1, 2, 3].map(n => { return n * 2; });

title: JavaScript JSON.parse SyntaxError
description: Parsing a JSON string fails because the input is malformed.
root_cause: The string contains invalid JSON syntax, such as trailing commas or incorrectly quoted property names.
solution: Validate the JSON structure and handle SyntaxError when parsing untrusted input.
fixed_code: const data = JSON.parse('{"name": "Ada"}');

title: JavaScript incorrect equality comparison
description: A comparison produces unexpected results because values have different types.
root_cause: Loose equality performs type coercion that may not match the intended comparison.
solution: Use strict equality with === when type coercion is not intended.
fixed_code: console.log(5 === "5");
